page.overview:
Who is Slip-Stream?

Slip-Stream is a G.I. Joe character from the A Real American Hero and G.I. Joe vs. Cobra series.

Slip-Stream headed a successful air strike on a Cobra base on Grave Island in the Mekong Delta in Vietnam. He was then part of a training mission in Norway that was attacked by Rattlers and a Night Raven. All the Cobra planes were shot down but it was unclear which Joe got the kill on the Night Raven.

Sometime later, he and a female Strato-Viper shoot each other down over a seemingly deserted island, only to find that it was a lab belonging to Dr. Mindbender, who still has the Cobra base and the escaped mutation within under surveillance.
